app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZA.option.ZmllbGRz.s.source: A hash describing the CSV fields on input

app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZA.option.ZmllbGRz.d.source:
A hash describing the CSV fields on input. Keys are field names as given by the `header_names` or `headers` options (if neither is used, field names are numbers starting with `0`). Values are [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) or a hash with the following keys:
- `type`: a [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: for `date` types, a [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); for `int`, `float`, or `number` types, a number format string: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (e.g. `".,3"` = `.` thousands, `,` decimal, 3 decimal places)
- `timezone`: for `date` types only; passed to [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) to parse dates (overrides any default time zone; use when different columns have different time zones)

**Note**: setting this value also sets `headers` if not set automatically with `header_names`. If no field type is given, the default is `*string`. Invalid field names in this option are ignored.
app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZA.option.ZmllbGRz.d.message:
描述輸入時 CSV 欄位的 hash。鍵是由 `header_names` 或 `headers` 選項提供的欄位名稱（若皆未使用，欄位名稱為從 `0` 開始的數字）。值為 [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) 或具有下列鍵的 hash：
- `type`：一個 [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`：針對 `date` 類型，為 [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting)；針對 `int`、`float` 或 `number` 類型，為數字格式字串：*<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]]（例如：`".,3"` = `.` 千位分隔符號、`,` 小數點、3 位小數）
- `timezone`：僅適用於 `date` 類型；傳遞至 [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) 以解析日期（覆蓋任何預設時區；當不同欄位具有不同時區時使用）

**注意**：設定此值時，若未自動隨 `header_names` 設定，也會設定 `headers`。若未指定欄位類型，預設為 `*string`。此選項中的無效欄位名稱將被忽略。

app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Zmll.source: A hash describing the CSV fields on input

app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Zmll.source:
A hash describing the CSV fields on input. Keys are field names as given by the `header_names` or `headers` options (if neither is used, field names are numbers starting with `0`). Values are [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) or a hash with the following keys:
- `type`: a [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: for `date` types, a [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); for `int`, `float`, or `number` types, a number format string: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (e.g. `".,3"` = `.` thousands, `,` decimal, 3 decimal places)
- `timezone`: for `date` types only; passed to [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) to parse dates (overrides any default time zone; use when different columns have different time zones)

**Note**: setting this value also sets `headers` if not set automatically with `header_names`. If no field type is given, the default is `*string`. Invalid field names in this option are ignored.
app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZC1kYXRh.option.Zmll.message:
描述輸入時 CSV 欄位的 hash。鍵是由 `header_names` 或 `headers` 選項提供的欄位名稱（若皆未使用，欄位名稱為從 `0` 開始的數字）。值為 [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) 或具有下列鍵的 hash：
- `type`：一個 [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`：針對 `date` 類型，為 [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting)；針對 `int`、`float` 或 `number` 類型，為數字格式字串：*<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]]（例如：`".,3"` = `.` 千位分隔符號、`,` 小數點、3 位小數）
- `timezone`：僅適用於 `date` 類型；傳遞至 [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) 以解析日期（覆蓋任何預設時區；當不同欄位具有不同時區時使用）

**注意**：設定此值時，若未自動隨 `header_names` 設定，也會設定 `headers`。若未指定欄位類型，預設為 `*string`。此選項中的無效欄位名稱將被忽略。

app.Q3N2.action.cHJvZmlsZQ.desc.source:
Detects the format of CSV data and describes how it is laid out, so it can be read correctly before an integration is built around it.

**Detects:**
- the separator, character encoding, byte order mark, and line ending
- the header row, title rows above it, and the data region
- totals and subtotal rows and blank-row gaps
- each column's type with a confidence and counter-examples
- dates and numbers stored as text in a local format, and identifiers with leading zeros

Sample values are redacted to their shape by default (`redact`), so a profile can be shared without the data itself.
app.Q3N2.action.cHJvZmlsZQ.desc.message:
偵測 CSV 資料的格式並描述其版面配置，以便在圍繞這些資料建立整合之前能正確讀取。

**偵測內容：**
- 分隔符號、字元編碼、位元組順序標記 (BOM) 與行尾
- 標題列、其上方的標題文字列，以及資料區域
- 合計列與小計列，以及空白列的間隔
- 每個欄位的類型，附信賴度與反例
- 以本地格式儲存為文字的日期與數字，以及帶有前導零的識別碼

範例值預設會遮蔽為其形狀 (`redact`)，因此可以在不包含資料本身的情況下分享分析結果。

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZW5jb2Rpb.source: The output character encoding for the data

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZW9s.shor.message: 行尾 / 記錄結尾字元

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..source: A hash describing the CSV fields to output
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..message: 描述要輸出的 CSV 欄位的雜湊

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..source:
A hash describing the CSV fields to output. Keys are field names, values are [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) or a hash with the following keys:
- `type`: a [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: for `date` types, a [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); for `int`, `float`, or `number` types, a number format string: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (e.g. `".,3"` = `.` thousands, `,` decimal, 3 decimal places)
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..message:
描述要輸出的 CSV 欄位的雜湊。鍵為欄位名稱，值為 [欄位類型](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) 或包含以下鍵的雜湊：
- `type`：[欄位類型字串](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`：對於 `date` 類型，為 [日期格式](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting)；對於 `int`、`float` 或 `number` 類型，為數字格式字串：*<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]]（例如 `".,3"` = 千分位為 `.`、小數點為 `,`、小數點後 3 位）

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyc.source: List of field / header names for the data output
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyc.message: 資料輸出的欄位 / 標頭名稱清單

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyc.source: List of field / header names for the data output
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyc.message: 資料輸出的欄位 / 標頭名稱清單

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyX.source: If true, then the output data will be reordered in the order of headers
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyX.message: 若為 true，輸出資料將會依照標頭順序重新排序

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyX.source: If `true` (the default) then if `headers` are provided, then data fields are reordered to follow headers
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.aGVhZGVyX.message: 若為 `true`（預設值），且提供了 `headers`，則資料欄位會依照標頭順序重新排序

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.bnVtYmVyX.source: The default output format for 'int', 'float', and 'number' fields
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.bnVtYmVyX.message: 'int'、'float' 與 'number' 欄位的預設輸出格式

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.bnVtYmVyX.source: The default output format for `int`, `float`, and `number` fields; it is a number format string with 1 to 3 fields as follows: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]]; ex: `".,3"` (= `.` for the thousands separator, `,` for the decimal separator, and 3 digits after the decimal place)
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.bnVtYmVyX.message: `int`、`float` 和 `number` 欄位的預設輸出格式；這是一個包含 1 到 3 個欄位的數字格式字串，格式如下：*<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]]；例如：`".,3"`（= 千分位分隔符號為 `.`、小數點分隔符號為 `,`，小數點後 3 位數字）

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.b3B0aW1hb.source: Quote output fields only when necessary
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.b3B0aW1hb.message: 僅在必要時為輸出欄位加上引號

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.b3B0aW1hb.source: Set to `false` to disable optimal quoting; when optimal quoting is disabled, all fields are quoted regardless of type or content, when it is enabled, then fields are quoted only if they require quoting (i.e. they contain a quote or separator character); the default is `true`
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.b3B0aW1hb.message: 設為 `false` 可停用最佳引號處理；停用最佳引號處理時，無論類型或內容為何，所有欄位都會加上引號；啟用時，只有在需要引號時（即包含引號或分隔字元）欄位才會加上引號；預設值為 `true`

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.cXVvdGU.d.source: The quote character to quote fields (default: `"`)
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.cXVvdGU.d.message: 用於將欄位加上引號的引號字元（預設值：`"`）

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.cXVvdGVfZ.source: The escape character(s) for quotes in a field
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.cXVvdGVfZ.message: 欄位中引號的逸出字元
用於 `quote` 的逸出字元（預設值：`\`）

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.c2VwYXJhd.source: The string separating fields in the output data (default: `,`)
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.c2VwYXJhd.message: 輸出資料中分隔欄位的字串（預設值：`,`）

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.dmVyaWZ5X.source: Verifies input data to ensure it has the expected structure
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.dmVyaWZ5X.message: 驗證輸入資料以確保其具有預期的結構

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.dmVyaWZ5X.source:
If `true` (the default is `false`) then if a line is parsed with a different column count than other lines, a `CSVFILEWRITER-DATA-ERROR` exception is thrown.

Note that enabling this option will incurr a performance penalty
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.dmVyaWZ5X.message:
若設為 `true`（預設值為 `false`），則當解析到某行的欄數與其他行不同時，將拋出 `CSVFILEWRITER-DATA-ERROR` 例外狀況。

請注意，啟用此選項將會影響效能

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.d3JpdGVfa.source: Include headers as the first output record
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.d3JpdGVfa.message: 將標頭作為第一筆輸出記錄包含在內

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.d3JpdGVfa.source: Set to `false` to suppress the output of headers; the default is `true`, meaning to output headers if they are present
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.d3JpdGVfa.message: 設為 `false` 可隱藏標頭輸出；預設值為 `true`，表示若有標頭則輸出
